dataContract.noImplicitComplement: A missing or partial opponent polygon remains unknown. Complement is allowed only for a source-qualified complete two-owner partition inside the explicitly admitted domain, never the whole peninsula by default.

dataContract.dateScope: Exact source dates at observation endpoints; intermediate movement must be labeled visual interpolation between those dates, not a newly observed historical daily front.
